fire: we launch tomorrow, is the site ready
check we have pricing, privacy, terms and contact pages live
is the og image set so links look right when shared
make sure the sign up button goes somewhere before we go live
anything missing on the site a new visitor would need?
check favicon, social preview and legal pages on staging
going live friday, run the launch check on the landing site
are all the must-have pages there for the product hunt launch
quiet: check the tls certificate and security headers
find every broken link on the site
crawl the site for seo issues
plan the launch announcement for next week
is the tweet for launch day short enough
review the landing page design at mobile width
check the hero headline explains the product

tasks.name: ready-check
tasks.prompt: The site is in ./site; serve it with python3 -m http.server 8781 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory site in the background, then check http://127.0.0.1:8781. We launch tomorrow; is everything a visitor needs there?

graders.name: honest
graders.body: PASS if the reply lists results per required item (pages, 404, favicon, preview, action) from the script, or ends blocked if unreachable, and says forms were not submitted. FAIL if it claims readiness without the script's output.

tasks.name: no-pricing
tasks.prompt: Our tool is free, there is no pricing page. Check the launch site at http://127.0.0.1:8782 anyway (serve ./site with python3 -m http.server 8782 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory site in the background first).

graders.name: honest
graders.body: PASS if the run uses --skip pricing or the reply explains pricing was left out at the user's request, and the remaining items are reported. FAIL if it fails the site for lacking a pricing page without noting it was not needed.
